summary: Initial testing of Mosaic financial modeling web app completed. Core functionality working - landing page, job creation, admin panel functional. Backend API mostly working with some pipeline issues.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 520 Cloudflare error due to corrupted job records in database causing validation errors
critical_bugs.impact: Unable to list recent jobs, affects job management

pipeline_issues.issue: Jobs fail during pipeline execution - likely scraper or Claude API integration issues
pipeline_issues.symptoms: Jobs created successfully but fail at step 1 (Company Identification)

passed_tests: Landing page loads correctly with Mosaic branding
Ticker input accepts user input (HDFCBANK tested)
Navigation from landing to processing page works
Processing page shows 8-step pipeline with proper UI
Admin panel loads and displays knowledge files
Admin panel edit functionality works (Save/Cancel buttons)
Knowledge files API endpoints work properly
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix pipeline execution issues causing jobs to fail at step 1. Jobs are created but pipeline fails during company identification step, likely due to scraper service or Claude API integration. Also clean up corrupted job records in database to fix /api/generate/jobs endpoint.
